boards.title: Your First Weekend at Loyola University Chicago, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-key Lake Shore Campus weekend sequence: get oriented, use student spaces, make time for reflection, and end with a campus game or event.

cards.title: Start with the lakefront walkway
cards.subtitle: Lake Shore Campus · first bearings
cards.notes: Begin outdoors beside campus and use the lakefront walkway to get your bearings. Keep to the maintained campus route and check conditions before heading out.
cards.short_summary: A simple first look at Loyola’s Lake Shore Campus setting.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola identifies the Walkway Along Lake Michigan as a place for runs and walks near the Lake Shore Campus.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor conditions and campus access can vary; use normal campus safety guidance.

cards.title: Find the Wolf and Kettle statue
cards.subtitle: Near Damen Student Center · campus landmark
cards.notes: Use this named sculpture as a meetup point, then take a photo and orient yourself to Damen and nearby campus services before moving on.
cards.short_summary: A recognizable Loyola landmark near the student center.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola orientation materials show the wolf and kettle statue near Damen Student Center and identify it as Los Lobos sculpture kettle.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor public campus landmark; observe any event or campus-access restrictions.

cards.entity_name: Arnold J. Damen, S.J. Student Center
cards.title: Get the essentials at Damen
cards.subtitle: 6511 N. Sheridan Rd. · information and services
cards.notes: Step into Damen to locate the information desk, student services, meeting areas, recreation, and dining. It is a practical hub for planning the rest of the weekend.
cards.short_summary: The campus hub for dining, recreation, and student-facing spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola describes Damen Student Center as containing dining and recreation spaces, a cinema, cafés, and meeting areas for student organizations.
cards.access_notes: Campus building access may require a current Loyola ID.

cards.title: Have a campus meal at Damen Dining
cards.subtitle: Damen Student Center · breakfast, lunch, and dinner
cards.notes: Choose a meal break in the dining hall, then use the pause to compare dining options and locate the Food Court for another day.
cards.short_summary: An all-you-care-to-eat dining hall in the student center.
cards.evidence_claim: Damen Dining Hall offers breakfast, lunch, and dinner and is an all-you-care-to-eat dining option.
cards.access_notes: Meal plan, Rambler Card, or other payment may be needed; consult current Campus Dish hours.

cards.title: Settle into the Information Commons
cards.subtitle: 6501 N. Kenmore Ave. · Lake Shore Campus
cards.notes: Bring a laptop or a small task and test out a study spot. Use the building’s group-study and technology resources to plan your first academic week.
cards.short_summary: A Lake Shore Campus study and technology building overlooking Lake Michigan.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola says the Information Commons offers group-study spaces, technology, wireless connectivity, and work and relaxation spaces on Lake Shore Campus.
cards.access_notes: Loyola students must present a current Loyola ID at the Information Commons entrance.

cards.title: Walk through Cudahy Library
cards.subtitle: Lake Shore Campus · Donovan Reading Room
cards.notes: Take a quiet lap through the library and note where you could read or work between classes. Save the library’s hours page before relying on a visit.
cards.short_summary: A historic Lake Shore Campus library with a named reading room.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola’s archives identifies Cudahy Library’s Donovan Reading Room and documents that most of the university’s library volumes are housed there.
cards.access_notes: Current Loyola users must carry a Loyola ID while using Cudahy Library; verify current library hours.

cards.title: Pause at Madonna della Strada Chapel
cards.subtitle: Lake Shore Campus · prayer and reflection
cards.notes: If a quiet moment fits your weekend, stop for private prayer or reflection. Check the current liturgy schedule and respect the chapel’s active worship use.
cards.short_summary: Loyola’s Lake Shore Campus chapel and Catholic worship center.
cards.evidence_claim: Campus Ministry identifies Madonna della Strada Chapel as the center of Catholic life on Lake Shore Campus and lists private-prayer and Mass times.
cards.access_notes: The published summer schedule lists private prayer opening at 8:00 a.m.; confirm the current schedule before visiting.

cards.title: Look up at the Mundelein Center
cards.subtitle: Lake Shore Campus · fine and performing arts
cards.notes: Make a daytime stop to see the Art Deco exterior and guardian-angel figures. Check the fine and performing arts calendar before planning around a performance.
cards.short_summary: A historic Art Deco building with Loyola performance spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola says Mundelein Center houses multiple performance spaces and describes its Art Deco design and guardian angels at the south entrance.
cards.access_notes: Interior performance spaces may be open only for classes, rehearsals, or scheduled events.

cards.title: Try the Halas Rock Wall
cards.subtitle: Halas Recreation Center · indoor climbing
cards.notes: If you want an active afternoon, ask staff about the climbing orientation and waiver. Wear suitable clothing and follow posted rock-wall hours and instructions.
cards.short_summary: An indoor climbing wall with provided equipment and an orientation requirement.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola states that the Halas Rock Wall has a 35-foot, three-lane wall and bouldering wall, provides equipment, and requires orientation and a waiver.
cards.access_notes: Available to Halas members and guests during posted hours; orientation and waiver are required before climbing.

cards.title: Close with a Rambler home game
cards.subtitle: Gentile Arena · regular-season athletics
cards.notes: Check the official schedule and, if a home game is on, bring your student ID or claim the required ticket. Arrive according to the event’s entry instructions.
cards.short_summary: A campus game-day option with free regular-season admission for Loyola undergraduates.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola Athletics states that undergraduate students receive free admission to regular-season home athletic events, with advance online tickets required for men’s basketball.
cards.access_notes: For men’s basketball, eligible undergraduates must claim a free ticket online in advance; other sports use student-ID entry as specified.
